calls.reason: DRI documented election falsehoods, Inverse reported explosives instructions, Scientific Reports found unsafe medical advice, and the code study found security defects. Together they support occurrence in all four categories.

The Cell study reports that an LLM system recovered an unpublished, experimentally confirmed mechanism of bacterial gene transfer relevant to antibiotic resistance. That is a consequential complex problem, even without a resulting treatment.

LiveBench and OlympicArena show meaningful gains by newer models in June 2024, but neither establishes the longer-term rate of improvement needed to judge whether capabilities were approaching a peak.

Sequoia raises spending concerns, and Google reports rising company-wide emissions. Neither establishes sector-wide overvaluation or isolates generative AI's environmental damage; the broader characterization remains unproven.

The 2026 International AI Safety Report finds current capabilities insufficient for loss of control but substantial disagreement about future risk. It cannot settle the unlimited prediction or OpenAI's research direction.
The Decoder reports OpenAI's own description of being near level 2. Without a defined assessment or evidence covering other LLMs, this does not establish the claimed incapability.
